title: Ran the same opening range breakout three times on QQQ and the highest win rate was the only losing version
author: person-person12
selftext:
Same entry rules, same candles, same date range. The only thing I changed between the three runs was how far away the take profit sat.

QQQ 5 minute candles, january 2020 through december 2025, 116,677 candles, 100k account, run in [Agenticks](https://www.agenticks.ca/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=autopilot&utm_content=ai_trading). Commission and slippage charged on both sides of every trade.

**1:1 target** 1,058 trades, **54.5% win rate**, profit factor 0.99, net **-2.3%**, max drawdown 22.2%

**1:2 target** 1,057 trades, 48.3% win rate, profit factor 1.03, net +6.96%, max drawdown 24.4%

**1:3 target** 1,056 trades, 47.7% win rate, profit factor 1.04, net +9.96%, max drawdown 24.3%

The version that wins more than half its trades is the one that gives money back, and the two that lose more often than they win are the two that finish green. Entry count moved by two trades across all three runs so the setup itself never changed, only where it got paid.

Worth adding that on the 1:1 run the commission and slippage came to **$17,237** across those 1,058 trades, which turned a +14.94% gross into the -2.3% above.

1:3 beating 1:2 by three points over six years isnt an edge, its noise, and I wouldnt put money behind any of the three at a 1.04 profit factor with a 24% drawdown. The win rate is the number thats actually misleading here, because the only run that won more than half its trades is the only one that finished down.
